review_note: Reviewed 2026-10-25 from six completed compact-union CASSCF probes at 2, 2.5 and 30 angstrom in both bases. Select CAS(5,4), natural 19-22 of the 2 angstrom record. Added occupied S2 donor canonical 19 joins the original CH2-frontier/HSS-radical source 20-22. At separation the occupations are 2/1/1/1; near 19 and 22 carry C/S bonding-antibonding character, 20 sulfur p and 21 carbon p. Near occupations are 1.96228,1.49558,1.00285,0.53930 (DZ) and 1.96279,1.49549,1.00287,0.53885 (TZ). This corrects the missing carbon-frontier character of the CAS(3,3) near solution without adding other valence bonds. One Q and one D have total weights 0.5 each. Selected from native occupations and AO coefficients, not an energy-window rule. These fixed-geometry CASSCF screens select a production model; they do not establish quantitative CASPT2-F12, angular or asymptotic-plateau convergence. Preserve production orbital, root and connectivity checks. State averaging is optimization support; only D1 contributes reactive flux. Direct CASPT2-F12 uses avdz-f12/avtz-f12 CBS power 3.7 and the separate 30 angstrom asymptote.
